npm_audit_before.note: maplibre-gl@4.5.0 was NOT yet flagged in the pre-upgrade audit snapshot taken in this session, but the same advisory database entry (GHSA-jrc7-96c5-q579, critical, XSS Sanitizer Bypass, affects <=6.4.0) applies to it -- confirmed after upgrading and re-auditing. data_payload_before.loading_strategy: grid_map.geojson fetched in full by every map page on mount (base geometry + ALL ~19 analytical/categorical fields for every layer on every page, even though each page only colors by 1-3 of them); grid_attributes.json (all 36 fields x 22,322 cells) fetched in full, once, client-side, on first Grid Intelligence Card open, cached in a module-level singleton for the rest of the session.

production_build_before.build_status: Compiled successfully, 0 TypeScript errors (confirmed at the end of Phase 13.1)

route_structure_before.client_server_boundary: Pages are async server components (data.ts reads public/data/*.json via fs); MapView, GridIntelligenceCard, PageMapExplorer, Sidebar, Navigation are 'use client'
